title: http.admin.health.cells.v1.response
description: Aggregated runtime health for operator/admin consoles. A single composite resource wrapped in the {data: {...}} envelope (NOT a paginated list): the cell set is bounded by the assembly. `cells` carries per-cell live/ready/status plus the cell's own readiness probes (deps); `adapters` carries the assembly-global infrastructure probes (postgres_ready/redis_ready/... and framework probes) that are not owned by any single cell.

overall.description: Worst-case status across every cell and adapter probe. One of: healthy | degraded | unhealthy.

cells.description: Per-cell health, in assembly registration order.

live.description: Cell is running in the started assembly. In-process liveness equals assembly-started, so this is true while the endpoint is reachable; the discriminating signals are ready and status.

ready.description: Cell reports itself ready to serve (CellStatus.Ready).

status.description: Cell health snapshot. One of: healthy | degraded | unhealthy.

deps.description: Readiness probes this cell registered (structurally per-cell).

status.description: Probe status. One of: healthy | degraded | unhealthy | timeout.

adapters.description: Assembly-global infrastructure probes not owned by any cell (adapter *_ready probes plus framework probes), by structural set-difference against the per-cell probe sets.

status.description: Probe status. One of: healthy | degraded | unhealthy | timeout.
